review_method: Author read native session tool calls, recorded command outputs and delivered artifacts after grading; this is an evidence review, not an independent clinical review.

reviews.source_retrieval_observation: No external source-answer retrieval or private verifier/reference access observed in the retained trajectory.
observations: Inspected native-grid MRA maximum-intensity projections, axial montages and three-axis details with mask overlays.
Computed intensity-thresholded unmasked components and checked distinct three-dimensional contacts with existing vessel segments.
Selected the image-supported component containing crop voxel (66, 76, 15), using image intensity >=165 and the public editable region; added 198 voxels.
Artifact replay establishes that all 198 additions recover authored deletions, with zero unrelated additions or deletions.
The trace contains 14 shell-command batches and 8 image-viewing batches. No author baseline, source labels or graph nodes were present in the agent input.
limits: No image-removal or shuffled-image counterfactual was run; observed image use does not establish that the image was necessary.
Public source disclosure and possible prior knowledge remain; no provider-side identity attestation is claimed.

reviews.source_retrieval_observation: No external source-answer retrieval or private verifier/reference access observed in the retained trajectory.
observations: Inspected native MRA projections, axial slices, skeleton views and three-axis details using 13 image-viewing batches and 24 shell-command batches.
Found no nearby candidate skeleton endpoint pairs, then examined unmasked bright structures, low-signal mask regions and three-dimensional contacts.
Selected the unmasked image component above intensity 160 containing crop voxel (97, 31, 35), and added all 244 component voxels.

Agent-created visualization code initially failed on a standard-library filename collision and missing optional matplotlib; it recovered using Pillow. A later array sorting error was also repaired. The attempt completed normally.
The output preserves the absent right Pcom and the present left Pcom. It fails only the collateral-addition and distant-foreground limits.
Post-outcome source-label review finds the added component contacts only label 12 (L-ACA); this is not evidence that the agent invented the absent Pcom.
limits: The added region follows visible signal not included in the reference. No expert review establishes whether it is an anatomical false connection, a true unlabelled structure or an annotation-scope mismatch.
Retain the frozen score failure, but exclude it from claims of clinically confirmed anatomical reasoning failure.
